name: Dihedral
description: Mirror and quarter-turn together — the symmetry a square actually has.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 60% 40%, 0 100%); clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 60% 40%, 0 100%); @match(@x > @X / 2) { -webkit-transform: rotate(90deg); transform: rotate(90deg); } @match(@y > @Y / 2) { -webkit-transform: rotate(-90deg); transform: rotate(-90deg); } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
